summary: xAI announced a partnership making Grok Voice the default text-to-speech engine for Vapi's voice agent platform, which hosts over 2.5 million voice agents, and made Grok Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech available directly in the Vapi Dashboard.

mechanisms.reason: Grok Voice becoming the default engine across an existing base of millions of voice agents on a third-party platform would substantially increase the volume of Grok inference calls served.
mechanisms.quote: bringing a new level of naturalness and emotional range to the 2.5M+ voice agents built on the Vapi platform

practices.reason: The partner's blind, head-to-head evaluation methodology comparing voice providers is a measurement approach worth knowing about but is not transferable or detailed enough to run ourselves.
practices.quote: Vapi conducted an independent, blind evaluation comparing Grok Voice against other providers. In their head-to-head arena, Grok took the #1 spot.

practices.reason: Developers building on Vapi gain a new selectable voice engine and direct dashboard access to Grok's speech APIs, a minor interface change rather than a breaking one.
practices.quote: Grok Speech-to-Text and Text-to-Speech are now available in the Vapi Dashboard.
